trecho: Sabe onde a Moranguete tá agora, Bananildo?
descricao: Primeiro quadro: a caneca do Bananildo em primeiro plano, no centro (a frase dela entra por cima, no alto), e o Colega logo atrás, debruçado na divisória, de sobrancelha erguida. A ironia está no quadro 1.
prompt_cena: Bananildo the banana, seen from behind at the right edge, holds the white mug up in the foreground, the mug sharp in the center of the frame; just behind it, the pineapple coworker leans over the cubicle divider facing him, one eyebrow cocked, a gossipy half smile, dramatic telenovela lighting

descricao: O Bananildo afundado na mesa, entre pilhas de papel, e o Colega debruçado sobre ele: o 'todo santo dia' do trabalho.
prompt_cena: Bananildo the banana slumps at his cluttered desk between towers of paperwork, exhausted, typing; the pineapple coworker leans over the divider above him, pointing at him with a sly knowing look, the white mug beside the keyboard, faces in the middle of the frame

descricao: Close do Bananildo, orgulhoso e cansado, abraçado à caneca: a ingenuidade dele.
prompt_cena: Bananildo the banana smiles with tired proud eyes behind his round glasses, hugging the white mug against his chest, head tilted, utterly naive and in love, a warm desk-lamp glow on his face

trecho: E cuida do corpo pra mim, lá na academia.
descricao: O Bananildo, recostado, faz muque com o braço fino, todo orgulhoso; atrás da divisória, o Colega segura o riso.
prompt_cena: Bananildo the banana leans back in his office chair and proudly flexes one skinny noodle arm, beaming; behind the cubicle divider, the pineapple coworker presses his lips together, holding back a smirk, eyes sliding sideways, dramatic office lighting

descricao: Close do Colega no deboche: olhos apertados, sobrancelha lá em cima. Ele sabe.
prompt_cena: the pineapple coworker narrows his eyes, one eyebrow cocked high, a slow sarcastic half smile, chin resting on his hand over the cubicle divider, a sideways glance full of suspicion, harsh dramatic side light
